system.description: Feyborn are beings whose bodies and spirits are intertwined with glamour, dreams, emotion, living nature, shadow, and other liminal forces. They may appear nearly mortal or possess features that openly reveal their supernatural nature. Feyborn may include long-lived woodland peoples, fair folk, winged sprites, horned revelers, embodied nature spirits, dreamborn beings, changelings of fey origin, and shadow-touched peoples.

nature.name: Between Places
nature.text: You may move through spaces occupied by other creatures, though you cannot end your movement in an occupied space. Choose one Feyborn Species Trait.

traits.name: Dreamtouched
traits.text: You remain aware of your surroundings while resting. Awareness can wake you from ordinary sleep when circumstances warrant, but does not let you act while still asleep or override injury-based unconsciousness. The first time each Encounter an effect alters your perception, memory, dreams, or emotions, you immediately recognize that an outside influence is affecting you, even if you cannot identify its source or prevent the effect.

traits.name: Glamour
traits.text: After one minute of preparation, you may assume a different appearance within your general size and body plan, altering apparent lineage, age, coloration, voice, scent, clothing, and similar details. This is not Concentration. The Glamour lasts until you end it, replace it, or become unconscious. Ordinary observation cannot identify it as false, though touch, deliberate examination, or supernatural Senses may reveal inconsistencies.

traits.name: Glimmerwing
traits.text: You possess wings or another supernatural means of controlled descent. You may glide using the Gliding procedure in Combat Encounters: Movement, including normal use of Dash. This Trait does not allow you to gain height or hover.

traits.name: Greenstep
traits.text: Natural vegetation, undergrowth, mud, roots, and similar natural terrain do not count as Difficult Terrain for you. You also gain Climb 5 when climbing living plants or natural rock.

traits.name: Gloamstep
traits.text: Gain Low-Light Vision. The first time each turn you enter dim light, darkness, or substantial shadow, move 1 additional unit without spending Movement.

traits.name: Veiled Presence
traits.text: You may suppress visible and sensory signs of your supernatural nature. While suppressed, ordinary magical or spiritual detection recognizes that you are alive but does not automatically identify you as Feyborn. Direct examination or an effect specifically designed to reveal Species may still expose you.

traits.name: Wild Escape
traits.text: The first time each Encounter another creature would prevent your movement, restrain you, or reduce your Movement to 0, you may immediately move 1 unit after that effect resolves. For this move only, ignore the movement restriction created by the triggering effect. This does not ignore unrelated restrictions or permit passage through a solid barrier. The triggering effect remains afterward unless its own ending condition has been met.
